item.title: Louis Castle on Westwood, Command & Conquer, and a New Secret Game
item.description: Louis Castle shared plenty of stories from his decades in the industry: the early days of Westwood, the creation of iconic RTS titles, working with movie licenses like Blade Runner and The Lion King, and collaborating with Steven Spielberg on Boom Blox. From the evolution of game development to the role of innovation, this conversation is a rare glimpse into the mind of one of gamings true pioneers.
